title: How the CIA Secretly Stole a Soviet Nuclear Submarine from 3 Miles Deep (Project Azorian)
description:
In 1968, Soviet nuclear submarine K-129 vanished 16,000 feet into the Pacific Ocean. The USSR couldn't find it. But the US Navy did.

What followed was Project Azorian: a $4 billion CIA operation disguised as a deep-sea mining venture by eccentric billionaire Howard Hughes using the Glomar Explorer. Discover the secret mechanics of Clementine Claw, the catastrophic hull snap at 9,000 feet, and the solemn burial at sea that birthed the legendary 'Glomar Response'.
